settings.name: endpoint
settings.label: OTLP endpoint
settings.hint: Any OTLP/HTTP endpoint, e.g. https://otlp-gateway-prod-us-east-0.grafana.net/otlp (traces go to /v1/traces).

settings.name: username
settings.label: Username / instance ID
settings.hint: Grafana Cloud: instance ID + an access-policy token. Blank: the token is sent as a Bearer token.

settings.name: token
settings.label: Token
settings.hint: Sent as Authorization: Basic (with a username) or Bearer.

settings.name: headers
settings.label: Extra headers (advanced)
settings.hint: Optional Name=Value pairs separated by commas.
